authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: Create a flintlock fantasy photograph as one coherent photographed moment: a woman guided by the supplied portrait is a signal courier pausing on a city rampart at blue dusk. Preserve the reference face proportions and features, and her short black bob with wispy bangs. Her face remains clearly visible in a three-quarter turn, her attention moving from the lantern in her hands toward a distant answering light across the moat. The quiet concentration and warmth reflected onto her cheek give her presence its restrained, personal appeal. She stands beside the low inner face of a stone parapet, with both boots supported on the broad dry walkway. At waist height her left hand supports the flat bottom of a brass signal lantern; her right hand closes its open side door around a small luminous dispatch wafer. The wafer casts a supernatural signal light through cut-out symbols onto the stone beside her. The connected hand, door, hinge and lantern body read as one workable action. Her wrists remain separate, with room between the lantern and her coat. A wooden-stock flintlock pistol rests in a fitted open holster at her near hip, its exposed cock and flint, priming pan and upright hinged frizzen presented toward the camera; the muzzle points down. A worn charcoal military coat, pale linen collar and narrow leather cross-belt suggest a working messenger rather than ceremonial display. The frame opens beyond her shoulder to a fortified city: the parapet leads into a massive angular wall, a water-filled moat runs directly along its base, and the opposite masonry watch post holds the small answering light. Both banks and the strip of dark water remain discernible together. Lower roofs behind the wall catch the last dim sky. The near lantern and the distant reply make the communication visually intelligible while the outcome remains open. Damp stone, abraded brass and water reflections give the imagined world ordinary weight. Compose a horizontal environmental portrait from thigh height upward, with the courier occupying the left half and the wall, moat and opposite watch post carrying the right. Use a natural 40 mm photographic perspective and enough depth to read the connected fortress geography. Cool sky light separates the black hair from the stone; warm lantern light models her face and hands. Keep the pistol lock, hand contact and her face within the readable focal zone, with subtle grain, natural skin texture and the tonal restraint of a carefully staged location photograph.
